summary: OpenAI announced an expanded strategic collaboration with BBVA under which the bank has scaled ChatGPT Enterprise to roughly 100,000 employees and is building custom GPTs and AI-driven workflows across risk, legal, customer service and operations as part of an eight-pillar AI transformation roadmap.

mechanisms.reason: The document states a large, quantified scale-up of ChatGPT Enterprise usage at one customer, from 3,000 to roughly 100,000 employees with high active-usage rates.
mechanisms.quote: Today more than 100,000 employees globally use ChatGPT Enterprise, making BBVA one of the largest enterprise adopters of generative AI in the financial sector.

categories.reason: AI tools are being built directly into core banking workflows such as credit risk assessment and legal advisory, crossing from general productivity into financial infrastructure functions.
categories.quote: In credit risk, BBVA developed Credit Analysis Pro GPT, which accelerates assessments by extracting and analyzing unstructured data from annual reports, ESG disclosures, and media coverage—work that was previously manual and time-intensive.
